description: This file implements utility functions for handling JSON Web Tokens (JWT), including token generation, validation, and claims extraction in a Spring Boot application.

classes.name: JwtUtil
classes.description: A utility class for generating and validating JWT tokens, encapsulating JWT claims handling and token creation logic.

methods.name: generateToken
methods.description: Creates a JWT token for the given UserDetails, embedding necessary claims.

methods.name: extractUsername
methods.description: Retrieves the username from a given JWT token.

methods.name: extractExpiration
methods.description: Retrieves the expiration date of the token.

methods.name: extractClaim
methods.description: Generic method to extract any claim from a token using a claims resolver function.

methods.name: extractAllClaims
methods.description: Parses the token and extracts all claims using the secret key.

methods.name: isTokenExpired
methods.description: Checks if the token has expired.

methods.name: validateToken
methods.description: Validates the token by matching username and expiration status.
